title: ACM Problem-Solving Platform
description: A web application designed to help users practice and solve ACM-style competitive programming problems.

features.name: Problem Library
features.description: A comprehensive library of ACM-style problems categorized by difficulty and topic.

features.name: Code Editor
features.description: An integrated code editor with support for multiple programming languages and real-time syntax highlighting.

features.name: Online Judge System
features.description: An automated system to evaluate code submissions and provide instant feedback on correctness and performance.

features.name: User Profiles
features.description: Personalized user profiles to track progress, achievements, and problem-solving history.

features.name: Leaderboard
features.description: A ranking system to encourage competition among users based on their problem-solving performance.

constraints: Requires a scalable backend to handle multiple concurrent users
Should provide real-time feedback on code submissions
target_users: Competitive programming enthusiasts, students, and professionals preparing for ACM contests.
data_requirements: Storage for user profiles, problem data, code submissions, and performance metrics.
